definitions.explanation: A casual short-sleeved shirt in the shape of a T when laid flat.

examples.japanese: Tシャツに{ジーンズ|じーんず}。
お{土産|みやげ}にTシャツを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a T-shirt as a souvenir.

notes:
Tシャツ is from English "T-shirt," named for its T-shape when laid flat. Standard casual wear in Japan.

PRONUNCIATION:
- ティーシャツ is standard
- テーシャツ is also commonly used

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- Tシャツを{着|き}る: to wear a T-shirt
- {無地|むじ}のTシャツ: plain T-shirt
- プリントTシャツ: printed T-shirt

RELATED CLOTHING:
- ポロシャツ: polo shirt
- {長袖|ながそで}Tシャツ: long-sleeve T-shirt
- タンクトップ: tank top
- カットソー: cut and sewn (knit top)
- ワイシャツ: dress shirt (from "white shirt")
